Ivy (Design): Heads-up — compact request card CTA congestion. Corr-id pill, tiny download chevron, and hover helper are overlapping on small screens. Users report triggering downloads when trying to copy. Anyone seen this? :grimacing:
Sam (EngRuntime): Yep. Support tickets noted accidental downloads. Download triggers a heavy snapshot fetch so our export service sees spikes.
Priya (Product): Curious if analytics show where downloads are coming from (compact vs detail). If compact is a common source, hiding it might affect workflows.
Ivy (Design): Quick query: analytics show ~28% of trace downloads start from compact cards last 30d. Proposal: make corr-id a single-tap copy, move Download into an overflow menu, and add a subtle keyboard hint (e.g., focus then press C) for power users.
Alex (Accessibility): Agree on separate primary action. For copy add aria-label=\"Copy correlation id\" and a polite live region that announces \"Correlation ID copied to clipboard\". Ensure overflow is keyboard-friendly (role=menu, arrow keys, esc closes).
Ken (EngPlatform): Dev plan: kebab after corr-chip, roving tabindex for actions, arrow-key menu nav. I'll add client-side debounce and server-side rate-limiter to exports. Also show a toast \"Preparing download...\" and a spinner for long exports.
Sam (EngRuntime): Backend: for large traces return 202 + job id, provide progress polling or a streaming download. Avoid long-running synchronous export requests. Add a size threshold (e.g., >5MB) that requires explicit confirm.
Priya (Product): UX tradeoff: hiding Download reduces accidental triggers but hurts discoverability. Suggest we keep Download on detail page and put it in overflow in compact view. Also capture telemetry: click source (compact/detail), and first-click-confirm counts.
Ivy (Design): I'll make two mocks: A) kebab-only (compact) + clear labels; B) inline tiny icon but show first-click confirm modal \"Download trace?\" with undo toast. I'll annotate a11y behaviors on both.
Alex (Accessibility): Prefer kebab-only for simpler SR experience. If we use confirm modal, ensure focus trap and clear announcements. Also verify shortcut doesn't conflict with browser/OS keys.
Ken (EngPlatform): Implementation checklist: keyboard order corr-chip -> kebab -> menu; menu items role=menuitem; escape closes; focus ring visible. NVDA and VoiceOver passes required.
Sam (EngRuntime): I'll add the 202/polling export flow and the size-warning header. Also add server-side telemetry for export origin.
Priya (Product): I'll update docs and support notes if we change behavior. We'll include a short release note explaining the change and the new shortcut.
Ivy (Design): Plan: post mocks in #design by EOD, tag @Ken and @Sam for engineering feasibility. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: design-review scheduled in #design 2024-07-01 14:00 UTC
Priya (Product): tagging @Alex for final a11y sign-off after implementation tests.
Alex (Accessibility): Will sign off after NVDA + VoiceOver checks, expect ~1 business day after PR.
Ivy (Design): Thanks everyone — keeping thread for follow-ups.
